activity_summary: At the turn of the stair you washed in cold water so the afternoon coat would not take the meal with it. Alse would not walk you to the gate. You said you would be out at the hour. Gib was off the stair.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Washed, took the cloak, and refused a speech at the door.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Set the basin, kept the board, and would not walk him out.

entities.name: the afternoon coat
entities.context: Mentioned in Washed in cold water before the afternoon

facets.activity: Washed, and left for the afternoon

quotes.speaker: alse_pinder
quotes.text: A playhouse is not a guest's hands.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I am not carrying a crumb into the coat Edith stitched.
